latestVersion.changelog:
Keevx Image-to-Video Skill 1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Enables conversion of images to videos using the Keevx API.
- Supports both Model V (general use, single/multi-image, audio, 4K) and Model KL (multi-reference images, up to 7).
- Allows various resolutions (720p, 1080p, 4K), adjustable duration, batch generation, and optional audio/narration.
- Handles both image URLs and local file uploads with clear API and error handling instructions.
- Includes task creation, status querying, robust polling recommendations, and callback notification support.
- Provides sample API requests, response formats, and practical usage tips.
